text: The following meetings of the Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority have been scheduled from July to December 2019: - Tuesday July 23 - 10:00 a.m. in Committee Room 1 - Friday September 20 - 10:00 a.m. in Committee Room 2 - Tuesday October 22 - 10:00 a.m. in Committee Room 1 - Monday November 25 - 3:30 p.m. in Committee Room 2 - Thursday December 12 - 10:00 a.m. in Committee Room 1 Toronto Parking Authority Board meetings are held at Toronto City Hall, 100 Queen Street West, in the committee rooms which are located on the second floor. The Board's meeting schedule is available on the City's website at www.toronto.ca/council . For further information or assistance, please contact Julie Lavertu, Administrator, Toronto Parking Authority Board of Directors, at 416-397-4592 or tpaboard@toronto.ca .
The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority received the item for information.
